gyms.name: Status City Gym
gyms.introText: Prof. Ada smiles warmly. 'Before you can be a Git trainer, you must learn the basics of a repository. Show me you can initialize, stage, and commit!'
gyms.winText: Prof. Ada nods approvingly. 'You've mastered the fundamentals! Take the Init Badge. The journey of a thousand commits begins with git init.'

gyms.name: Add Forest Gym
gyms.introText: Fern stands surrounded by branching trees. 'A true Git trainer never works on main! Branch early, branch often. Let's see if you know how.'
gyms.winText: Fern tosses you the Branch Badge. 'Never fear the branch. A repo without branches is like a forest with only one tree.'

gyms.name: Merge Valley Gym
gyms.introText: Vance cracks his knuckles. 'Merge conflicts are where weak trainers break. Show me your resolve. MERGE if you can!'
gyms.winText: Vance exhales slowly. 'You resolved every conflict without breaking. The Merge Badge is yours. Use rebase wisely — power like that can rewrite the past.'

gyms.name: Remote Shores Gym
gyms.introText: Marina gazes out at the network sea. 'All repos are islands, trainer. You must learn to connect them. Push and pull your way through my team if you dare!'
gyms.winText: Marina hands you the Remote Badge. 'The network is now your ocean. Always fetch before you push — that's wisdom, not weakness.'

gyms.name: Log Mountain Gym
gyms.introText: Chrono adjusts his spectacles. 'History is everything, young trainer. Those who cannot read the past are doomed to repeat bad commits. Read the log!'
gyms.winText: Chrono solemnly presents the Log Badge. 'Always know what came before. Every commit tells a story. Read them all.'

gyms.name: Stash Cave Gym
gyms.introText: Vera peers at you from behind a pile of stashed changes. 'I never discard work — I stash it. Let's see if your stash is as deep as mine.'
gyms.winText: Vera reluctantly hands over the Stash Badge. 'Fine. You earn it. But remember: a stash is temporary. Eventually you must commit or pop.'

gyms.name: Reset Ridge Gym
gyms.introText: Reza smiles darkly. 'History can be rewritten. Mistakes can be undone. The question is — do YOU know how?'
gyms.winText: Reza presses the Reset Badge into your hand. 'Use reset --hard sparingly. Once you lose history, it's gone. Unless... you know git reflog.'

gyms.name: Tag Tower Gym
gyms.introText: Semvera stands atop the tower, wind whipping her hair. 'Every great project has a v1.0. Every great trainer has their moment. This is yours. Show me everything you know!'
gyms.winText: Semvera bows deeply. 'You've mastered the full command set. Take the Version Badge. The Git Council Elite Four awaits. Are you ready to face Originex?'

eliteFour.name: Eli
eliteFour.title: Master of Files
eliteFour.introText: You've come far, trainer. But the Elite Four are not gym leaders.

eliteFour.name: Petra
eliteFour.title: Master of Branches
eliteFour.introText: The branch is your friend and your enemy. I'll show you why.

eliteFour.name: Neto
eliteFour.title: Master of Networks
eliteFour.introText: The remote is where the real battles happen. Push harder.

eliteFour.name: Syra
eliteFour.title: Master of Systems
eliteFour.introText: History is just the beginning. Let me show you what control really means.

champion.name: Champion Linus
champion.title: Git Champion
champion.introText: So you made it. I created the first repository on this island. Every branch, every commit, every push — I've seen them all. Let's end this.
champion.winText: ...You did it. A new champion emerges. The command line bends to your will. You are the greatest Git trainer this world has ever seen.
